newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse keeps Tuesday as settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse keeps Tuesday as settlement day.

text.p: Dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said Tuesday would be observed as settlement day and Wednesday as new accounts day.
"Brokers are doing stocks business and squaring positions on Tuesday's settlement day," a dealer at Fortune Securities said.
Before trading started, dealer Rony Byramjee had said: "We don't know whether Tuesday's settlement day has been postponed till Wednesday or not."
The exchange suspended trading on Monday because of power failure and protests by dealers.
